rationale: Prajyot brings deep ML/robotics software expertise from Meta across manipulation, sim-to-real pipelines, and robot learning frameworks, while Dhanush is building robotics solutions at xLogic Labs with a full-stack focus on perception and ROS architecture. Both work in robotics with complementary skill sets—Prajyot's strength in AI/ML and simulation (Isaac Sim, BC-GMM) pairs well with Dhanush's systems and perception background—making them natural collaborators for solving real-world robotics challenges.
intro_message: Prajyot Patil, meet Dhanush Baktha — you both work in robotics with complementary expertise (ML/sim-to-real vs. full-stack perception and architecture) and could explore how to bridge research and product at scale.
